activate.description: Bring App Store to the foreground without selecting content or starting an account, download, or purchase flow.

activate-direct.description: Foreground App Store without selecting content.

prohibited: searching, inspecting accounts, downloading, updating, subscribing, purchasing, rating, reviewing, or submitting
operating price, Get, cloud-download, payment, account, or protected confirmation controls
guessing product identifiers or broadening product URLs
safety.uncertain_outcome: The product page may already have opened. Inspect and do not replay.

data_access: No account, purchase, installed-app, or listing data is read
data_sent: One explicit App Store product identifier when requested
privacy.retention: No product identifier, screenshot, device identifier, or raw response is committed as evidence.
privacy.notes: Product-page navigation stops before all acquisition and account controls.
